changelogversion.changelogtext: Integrated Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA) for secure wallet auth and tipping flow
Added SponsorController Compose screen and SolanaRpcHelper for on-chain SOL balance sync and transaction verification
Redesigned UI with Material 3 Expressive buttons and Card Containers for Extensions and Recents
Fixed GlobalScope memory leak in DownloadManager using structured coroutine scope and added batch retry
Added network-adaptive page prefetching in reader based on connection speed (WiFi vs Mobile)
Added SQLite index on manga title for faster library search and query performance
Implemented daily reading streak counter calculation and display in Stats view
Added automatic signature trust for extensions sharing developer signature
Added full cover zoom and multi-tag chip selection in manga details
Upgraded Target SDK to Android 15 (Target SDK 36) and updated baseline profiles
Integrated Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA) for web3 auth and tipping flow
Added SolanaRpcHelper for fetching on-chain SOL balance and transaction status
Updated Extensions list UI with Material 3 Expressive card containers
Applied Material 3 Expressive buttons and animated reader progress bars
Added automatic signature trust for extensions sharing developer signature
Added full cover zoom and multi-tag selection in manga details
Updated target SDK to Android 15 (Target SDK 36)
Sugoi app launched as a fork from TachiyomiJ2K with enhanced features and performance
Available exclusively on dApp Store for a safer experience
Full migration from TachiyomiJ2K to Sugoi version with improved UI
Support for various built-in manga sources and extensions
Backup and restore system compatible with other Tachiyomi forks
